title: Portrait and Harvest
author: Sable Almeida
blurb: Theo Zhou, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must get the family out ahead of the count before the last resident signs the papers.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
